demande: I want an agent that answers my customers, I spend my evenings on emails.

reponses.question: What makes this urgent for you right now?
reponses.reponse: I spend my evenings answering emails, and the holiday rush is coming.

reponses.question: Roughly how many customer messages do you get per week, and through which channels?
reponses.reponse: About 80 a week, mostly email, a few on Instagram.

reponses.question: How many minutes does a typical request take you?
reponses.reponse: 5 to 10 minutes. Order tracking is the worst.

reponses.question: Who answers today, and which tools do you have open?
reponses.reponse: Only me, with my inbox and the shop back office.

reponses.question: What would count as a failure: a wrong answer, a cold tone, a promise made by mistake?
reponses.reponse: A wrong delivery date. That already happened once.

pistes.constat: Elle répond seule, le soir, à des messages de suivi de commande qui prennent 5 à 10 minutes chacun.
pistes.piste: Les réponses de suivi de commande pourraient l'attendre le matin, prêtes à relire, au lieu de lui prendre ses soirées.

pistes.constat: Une date de livraison fausse a déjà été donnée une fois.
pistes.piste: Les réponses sur les délais pourraient venir de l'état réel de la commande, jamais d'une estimation.

bilan_visiteur.recapitulatif: You run an online shop with 8 people, and you spend your evenings answering customer emails: about 80 messages a week, mostly by email, a few on Instagram. Order tracking is the heaviest, 5 to 10 minutes each. You are the only one who answers, and the holiday rush is coming. A wrong delivery date has already been given once, and that is what you would count as a failure.
pistes: Replies about order tracking could be waiting for you in the morning, ready to read and send, instead of taking your evenings.
Answers about delivery dates could come from the real status of the order, never from an estimate.

questions_ouvertes: Combien coûterait un agent, et en combien de temps serait-il prêt ? (question de la personne pour le consultant)
pour_la_base: Les clients professionnels ont-ils un interlocuteur à part ?
